metrics.title: → Moloko – Sing It Back (Boris Dlugosch mix) · 2A · 123 → Modjo – Lad...
metrics.description: → Moloko – Sing It Back (Boris Dlugosch mix) · 2A · 123 → Modjo – Lady (Hear Me Tonight) · 3A · 126 → Ultra Naté – Free · 4A · 125 The rule: go up one number on the wheel and keep the letter. Each new track feels like a lift but never clashes. 1️⃣ Push Sing It Back to 126 with key lock on, bring Lady in on the outro, and swap the bass on bar 9 2️⃣ Stay at 126, blend Free in over 16 bars, and echo out Lady's last "hear me tonight" What would you play next in 5A? 👇 #dj #djmix #djlife #djtransition #housemusic
